title: Activate updates only after durable consent
description: Announce waiting service-worker updates and activate/reload only after current drafts are verified durable and the user explicitly confirms a focus-safe controlled reload.
acceptanceCriteria: A waiting update is announced without silently replacing the running application
Update activation is blocked while any active draft lacks a confirmed durable-state marker
The prompt explains save, reload, offline, and cancellation consequences and defaults to the safe action
Explicit confirmation activates the waiting version and reloads only after durability verification succeeds
Cancellation or failed durability verification preserves the running version, work, and focus context

steps.details: Represent current, waiting, durability-checking, ready, activating, failed, and dismissed update states with structured diagnostics.
Query established repository/autosave durability markers for active work before enabling explicit activation.
Announce a waiting update, explain consequences, preserve a safe default, and manage cancel/confirm focus without trapping users.
Send activation only after successful durability check and consent, then perform one controlled reload with recoverable failure handling.
Simulate waiting, dirty, durable, cancel, failed check, activation failure, offline, and successful reload states.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use a mocked waiting worker and focused state tests.
The service worker must not treat cache completion as proof that IndexedDB drafts are durable.
